verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly supports a consistent workflow across machines. pnpm ships as a self-contained executable that needs no Node.js, and it pins the Node.js version per project to avoid "works on my machine" mismatches. It also auto-switches to the pnpm version set in package.json's packageManager field, and keeps shared config in pnpm-workspace.yaml. Nothing in the pack names macOS, Linux or Windows, or shows that this workflow and config behave identically on each. Missing for 10: explicit documented support for macOS/Linux/Windows, evidence of identical config and behavior per OS (e.g. symlink/hard-link handling on Windows), hands-on cross-platform corroboration.
